messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: lavaan ERROR: initial model-implied matrix (Sigma) is not positive definite
parts: An error is normally more serious than a warning, but here I would want to deal with the warning first. Researchers generally don't expect the covariance matrix of their variables to be not positive definite, and surprises need to be examined carefully. This is a very small model, so is should be easy to look for an explanation. Start by printing the covariance matrix for group 1. With so few variables, my first guess is either a data handling error, like mishandling missing data or just hving insufficient sample size, or a single correlation that is too close to 1 or -1. Regardless of the reason, I think you need to start by figuring out why the sample covariance matrfix is n.p.d.
